_comment: Template only. The real dat/config.json holds the CouchDB password and
the E2EE passphrase, is mode 0600, and is never versioned. Recover both
from KeePass. Peers sharing a group replicate with each other.
Hidden files (.obsidian, .stfolder, .git) are excluded by default, which
is deliberate: the phone keeps its own light plugin set.
